word-video-game.def: a form of electronic entertainment that you play on a screen with a controller or keyboard

word-gamer.def: someone who spends a lot of time playing on computers or consoles

word-game-console.def: a device that connects to a TV so you can play

word-controller.def: a handheld device with buttons and sticks that you use to play on a console

word-headset.def: headphones with a built-in microphone for listening and talking

word-load-game.def: to open a saved file of a game so you can keep playing

word-checkpoint.def: a place in a level where your progress is saved automatically

word-quest.def: a task that a character must complete to get a reward

word-mission.def: a job or goal that you must finish in a level

word-boss-game.def: a very strong enemy that you fight at the end of a level

word-game-character.def: a person, animal or creature that you play or meet in a story or game

word-avatar.def: a picture or figure that represents you online or in a game

word-multiplayer.def: a mode where several people play together or against each other

word-single-player.def: a mode where you play alone

word-server.def: a powerful computer that connects players in an online match

word-lag.def: a delay between your action and what happens on the screen online

word-patch.def: a small update that fixes problems in a program

word-bug.def: a mistake in a program that makes it work wrongly

word-glitch.def: a sudden small problem that makes something work wrongly

word-achievement.def: a reward that you get for completing a special task in a game

word-high-score.def: the best number of points that anyone has won

word-leaderboard.def: a list that shows the best players and their scores

word-inventory.def: the list of things that a character is carrying

word-item.def: an object that you can find, collect or use in a game

word-armor.def: strong clothing or equipment that protects a character from harm

word-health-points.def: a number that shows how much life a character has left

word-experience-points.def: points that you earn by playing and that help your character reach the next level

word-level-up.def: to move to a higher stage after earning enough points

word-respawn.def: to appear again after your character has died

word-open-world.def: a type of title with a huge map that you can explore freely

word-npc.def: a character that the computer controls instead of a real person

word-tutorial.def: a short lesson that teaches you how to use something or how to play

word-difficulty.def: how hard or easy something is to play

phrase-game-over.def: words shown on the screen when you lose and cannot continue

word-pause.def: to stop something for a short time and continue later

word-restart.def: to begin again from the beginning

word-settings.def: a menu where you change how a program or device works

word-graphics.def: the pictures and visual effects that you see on a screen

word-ending.def: the last part of a story, which shows how it finishes

word-sequel.def: a game or movie that continues the story of an earlier one

word-shooter-game.def: a type of title where you fight enemies with guns or other weapons

word-strategy-game.def: a type of title where you win by careful planning

word-role-playing-game.def: a type of title where you control a hero who grows stronger during a story

word-racing-game.def: a type of title where you drive fast vehicles against other drivers

word-simulator.def: a program that copies a real activity, such as flying or farming

word-esports.def: organized video competitions in which professional players win prizes

word-stream-v.def: to broadcast yourself live on the internet

word-streamer.def: a person who broadcasts live on the internet while playing

word-teammate.def: someone who plays on your side

word-guild.def: an organized group of players who play together regularly

word-voice-chat.def: talking with other players through a microphone while playing

word-noob.def: a beginner who plays badly, often said in an insulting way

phrase-good-game.def: what players say after a match to be polite

word-joystick.def: a stick that you move with your hand to control movement on a screen

word-aim.def: to point a weapon toward a target

word-defend.def: to protect someone or something against an attack

word-craft.def: to make items from materials that you have collected

word-explore.def: to travel around a place to find out what is there

word-unlock.def: to make something available that was closed or hidden

word-cooperative.def: done by working together with others toward one goal

word-damage-n.def: the harm done to a person or thing, or the life points taken away in a fight

word-critical-hit.def: a lucky strike that does much more harm than normal

word-cooldown.def: the time you must wait before you can use a power again

word-ping.def: the time it takes for a signal to travel between your computer and a server
